sections.content: The specification defines VDD semantic verification and Quick Dev recovery for independent, auditable execution. It preserves FR-1 through FR-17, NFR-1 through NFR-11, SM-1 through SM-4, and SM-C1 through SM-C3.
sections.title: Scope

sections.content: The system requires semantic contracts, exact many-to-many Acceptance ID coverage, real process execution, target and fixture binding, independent judging, layered evidence state and verification outcome, deterministic failure identities, reusable recovery artifacts, and nonzero execution.
sections.title: Contracts

sections.content: Canonical package roles, architecture authority, evidence snapshots, failure-ID construction, promotion ownership, and closed-snapshot reuse foundations are adopted. Comparator policy, judge lifecycle, rollback probes, unexpected-green proof, stop-loss thresholds, platform compatibility, and detailed reuse remain deferred.
